user.title: Fill in your Bird Buddy login credentials

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Bird Buddy
reauth_confirm.description: Enter credentials for the same Bird Buddy account.

error.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different Bird Buddy account.
error.social_auth_unsupported: This account requires social sign-in. Social sign-in is not supported by this integration.

data_description.polling_interval: Account polling interval in minutes (1–20), default 10. Postcard processing can fail independently of feeder telemetry.

legacy_postcard_contract.title: Update Bird Buddy postcard automations
legacy_postcard_contract.description: The report-token postcard workflow is no longer emitted. Use birdbuddy_new_postcard and postcard_id. Legacy strategy, confidence and sighting inputs have no verified equivalent; review the collection policy and explicitly choose selection_policy: server before enabling collection. Your automations have not been rewritten.

deprecated_postcard_aliases.title: Update Bird Buddy action field names
deprecated_postcard_aliases.description: Replace postcard.id with postcard_id and share_media with share. These equivalent aliases remain available through versions 0.2 and 0.3 and are scheduled for removal in {removal_version}. Keep selection_policy: server explicit.

postcard_intake.title: Bird Buddy postcard delivery needs attention
postcard_intake.description: Postcard processing reported {error_type}. Feeder telemetry can continue. Check diagnostics and the durable intake documentation before retrying failed events or uncertain collection actions. No uncertain action is automatically repeated.
